resilience_alpha.label: Exposure-Adjusted Resilience Alpha (shadow-cost method)
resilience_alpha.interpretation: Real spend compared against a fixed-price shadow baseline (Day-1 unit cost per vendor, quantity assumed constant), scaled by how much of total spend materials represent. Cannot separate price change from purchase-volume change without real quantity data.

retained_liquidity.label: Retained Liquidity Ratio
retained_liquidity.interpretation: Share of observed inflows retained as cash (checking + savings) rather than spent. Assumes zero opening balance; not a true bank balance.

growth_allocation_rate.label: Growth Allocation Rate
growth_allocation_rate.interpretation: Share of total observed spend directed to growth/tech outflows rather than routine operating categories.

supply_chain_concentration.label: Supply Chain Concentration Ratio
supply_chain_concentration.interpretation: Share of material spend concentrated in the single largest vendor. High values can mean pricing leverage or single-supplier dependency.

labor_intensity.label: Labor Intensity Ratio
labor_intensity.interpretation: Share of revenue consumed by payroll — a scalability proxy.

modernization_ratio.label: Modernization Ratio
modernization_ratio.interpretation: Tech/software spend relative to routine operating spend.

lease_inefficiency.label: Lease Inefficiency Ratio
lease_inefficiency.interpretation: Share of lease-plus-overhead spend going to renting rather than owning equipment.

peak_cash_gap.label: Peak Cash Gap
peak_cash_gap.interpretation: Longest observed stretch between major client deposits.
